final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(`T-BIL` / CRE) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14' GROUP BY CENTROMEA), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio FROM step1) SELECT step1.CENTROMEA, step1.avg_hgb, step1.avg_ratio, step1.avg_ratio / step2.overall_avg_ratio AS normalized_ratio FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step2.overall_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
